protocol.description: This protocol allows clients to act as virtual keyboards, injecting key events into the compositor's input pipeline for whichever surface holds keyboard focus.

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_manager_v1
interface.description: An object used to create virtual keyboard objects.

description.summary: create a new virtual keyboard object

arg.name: seat
arg.summary: the seat the keyboard will be attached to

interface.name: zwp_virtual_keyboard_v1
interface.description: The requests here replay key events through the compositor as if they came from a physical keyboard on the given seat.

request.name: keymap
request.description: Provide a file descriptor the compositor may mmap to read an XKB keymap describing this keyboard. Must be sent before the first key event.

request.name: key
request.description: `key` carries the Linux evdev keycode (not offset by 8).
